text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to recommend the installation of a stop control for eastbound traffic on Vicarage Court at Feller Road. This intersection is currently uncontrolled and the installation of a stop control will define the right-of-way, enhancing traffic management and safety at this location.
Etobicoke York Community Council deferred consideration of this Item to its meeting on June 6, 2018.
